answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 147803 Country: india Title: I would like to know our Prophet Muhammad (saws) drunk goat milk or cow milk? And also raw milk or boiled milk? Question: I would like to know our Prophet Muhammad (saws) drunk goat milk or cow milk? And also raw milk or boiled milk? Answer ID: 147803 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 539/529/SN=5/1438) Various Hadith speak that the Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) drank milk. A tradition explains that the Prophet (may peace be upon him) drank goat milk and it is known by the content of the narration that it was cold not hot. Thus it is recorded in Bukhari: عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ لَبَنًا، وَأَتَى دَارَهُ فَحَلَبْتُ شَاةً فَشُبْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْبِئْرِ، فَتَنَاوَلَ الْقَدَحَ فَشَرِبَالخ. It is also narrated in another tradition of the Bukhari: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ......... ثُمَّ حَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَاجِنٍ (تألف البيوت) لَهُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَشَرِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم . (بخاري ، 2/480، 839، رقم: 5395، 5396، 5404، اتحاد ديوبند)‏ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
